SectionSftp: --- SFTP parameters (used only if protocol is SFTP) ---
LabelSftpPort: SSH port (standard: 22, some providers use a different one)
LabelSshKeyFile: Private SSH key path (leave the field pointing to a non-existent file to use password auth instead)
LabelSshKeyPassphrase: SSH key passphrase (leave empty if the key has no passphrase)
LabelSftpPassword: Password (used only if the SSH key file above is not found)
SectionWebdav: --- WebDAV parameters (used only if protocol is WebDAV) ---
LabelWebdavPassword: Password (or app-password, if required by the provider)
LabelIsCryptomatorVault: This is a Cryptomator vault (raw encrypted folder -- requires locking before sync)
LabelVaultLocalPath: Local source folder (Cryptomator raw vault folder, or a plain folder if the checkbox above is unchecked)
LabelVaultDriveLetter: Drive letter when the vault is unlocked (only relevant if the checkbox above is checked)
LabelBandwidthMbit: Upload bandwidth limit in Mbit/s (0 = no limit)
ButtonGenKey: Generate new ed25519 SSH key (SFTP only)
LabelVaultStatusUnlocked: Vault: UNLOCKED ({0}) — lock it before syncing
MsgVaultLockedBody:
